data.narrative:
Starfish Space is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $100M+. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse, with particular relevance to same-stage and adjacent-stage companies in the sector.

Two quantitative methods anchor the analysis. Stage-progression modeling, using the $100M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a $190M valuation. Peer-median triangulation across four same-sector comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via Price-to-Sales multiples (median 25.3x across the six public tickers) is not applicable due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures for the target.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $162M to $1.9B, with a median point of $920M. The substantial width reflects material uncertainty around the appropriate peer discount or premium relative to the range of comparable valuations, as well as the target's specific operational maturity and technology differentiation within the sector. Stage-progression suggests the lower bound, while peer median anchors toward the midpoint.
